DRAIN

Give water the right way out.

A surface needs to direct water towards its outlet. Screeding forms the falls beneath the waterproofing and finish, and can be coordinated with the rest of a balcony or remedial scope.

Discuss this serviceSee our work

SOUND FAMILIAR?

Start with
what you can see.

  • Water pooling on a balcony or external deck
  • Drainage towards walls instead of the waste
  • A restoration that needs a new substrate and corrected falls

THE SCOPE

A system, step by step.

The written scope establishes what your particular building needs.

  1. 01

    Assess the levels

    Review the substrate, outlet and existing drainage arrangement.

  2. 02

    Prepare the base

    Prepare the area as part of the agreed remedial scope.

  3. 03

    Form the falls

    Lay screed towards the waste before the next system layers.

  4. 04

    Coordinate the finish

    Continue into waterproofing and tiling where included.

A FEW PRACTICAL ANSWERS

Before you
get started.

All common questions
Can screeding be part of the whole balcony restoration?

Yes. Screeding, membrane installation, tiling and sealing can be coordinated as one restoration scope.

Does correcting falls replace waterproofing?

No. Falls and waterproofing perform different jobs and need to be considered together as a system.
